༄༅/ /bla ma drag po pad+ma gling pa'i lugs kyi rjes gnang mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma drag po pad+ma gling pa'i lugs kyi rjes gnang mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

chos kyi sku las rang mdangs kyi// cho 'phrul gdul bya'i snang ngor shar// o rgyan pad+ma saṃ bha dang*// thod phreng sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig bla ma drag po'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga mdor bsdus bya bar 'dod na/ gtor ma dang mchod pa'i yo byad mthong ba rgyud pa ltar bshams la/ bdag bskyed dang ldan pa'i bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzlas la/ slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod cing me tog bkram la/ bgegs la ba liṃ sbyin zhing bka' bsgos te bskrad la/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob dpon dang bla ma drag po dbyer med pa'i drung du/ bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku// zhes gsum gyis skyabs 'gro dang*/ bdag nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi// zhes gsum gyis sems bskyed/ drag po thod phreng lha tshogs gshegs// zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa byas la/ slob ma rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma rak+sha srin po gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ dmar nag las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ thod phreng rtsal gyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal/ sku mdog dmar po nyi ma stong gi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gsum/ phyag drug /zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon ljang*/ dbus sku dang mthun pa/ spyan dgu dmar zhing zlum pa/ zhal mche ba drag tu gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug |bar pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ tha mas ral gri/ g.yon dang pos thod khrag /bar pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /tha mas lcags kyi sdig pa kha dgu mig dgu rwa bco brgyad dang ldan pa 'gyed thabs su 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon rdo rje rin po che'i gshog pa nam mkhar gdengs pa/ sku la gser gyi go khrab/ zhing chen/

seng ge/ glang gi pags pa dang*/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang*| dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ sku las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mthing kha g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa| skra grol ba rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa snang la rang bzhin med pa yab kyi spyi bor mkha' lding bya khyung rgyal po dang*/ dbu gsum gyi steng du rigs bdag tshe dpag med dang*/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ thod phreng rtsal yab yum bzhugs pa/ dpral bar 'jam dpal/ mgrin par rta mgrin/ thugs kar phyag rdor/ lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ gsang gnas su yak+sha me dbal dang bcas pa thams cad kyang rgyan dang cha lugs dang ldan pa phyag mtshan bsnams pa so sor gsal ba de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ lho nub rnga yab gling nas bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal yab yum la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang pos bskor ba spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i lus la mtsho la kha ba bab pa ltar thim par mos la/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ zangs mdog dpal ri 'og min pho brang nas// bde gshegs kun 'dus o rgyan pad+ma rje// bdag sogs mos ldan bu yis spyan 'dren na// myur du gshegs la bdag rgyud smin par mdzod// lho nub rnga yab srin po'i gling mchog nas// dbang drag pad+ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// yab yum 'khor dang rigs bzhi drag po dang*// khro bcu kī la sgo skyong gter srung bcas// myur du 'dir gshegs bdag dang slob mar bcas// smin cing lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib dag /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i don 'grub ste// dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs mchog thun 'grub pa yi// las kyi 'bras bu dam pas byin phob cig / ces dang*/ artsig nirtsig mjug tu ā we sha ya a āḥ zhes byin dbab/ de dag tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra

dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par byas la/ lus ngag yid gsum la sku gsung thugs kyi byin phab pa'i rtags gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ngo sprad do// dngos gzhi gtor ma'i dbang ni/ gtor ma bla ma drag po gong ltar ram/ las byang gang rung ltar bskyed la/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// drag po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma yis// dbang bzhi rdzogs par mdzad du gsol| | zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gtor ma thogs te/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba chos kyi sku// gtor ma drag po thod phreng longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs thugs rje'i rang mdangs sprul pa'i sku// sku yi dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thob shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes dpral bar bskur/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par bsam/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba chos kyi sku/ /gtor ma drag po thod phreng longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs thugs rje'i rang mdangs sprul pa'i sku// gsung gi dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thob shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa wā ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes mgrin par bskur| bdud rtsi sbyin/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ slob ma'i mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying po dang sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skal pa dang ldan par bsam/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba chos kyi sku// gtor ma drag po thod phreng longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs thugs rje'i rang mdangs sprul pa'i sku// thugs kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thob shog

/oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes snying gar gtad| gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ slob ma'i snying khar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*| 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par bsam/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba chos kyi sku// gtor ma drag po thod phreng longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs thugs rje'i rang mdangs sprul pa'i sku// dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i byin rlabs mchog thob shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ zhes spyi bor bskur/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ phrin las sna tshogs bsgru+ub pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par bsam/ bzlas pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags g.yas su 'khor bar dmigs te/ sngags kyi rjes zlos gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon gyis me tog dor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol| |phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ de nas bka' gtad bya bar 'dod na/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba thogs te/ hoḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku drag po thod phreng rtsal/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gzhan yang rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/

bla ma thod phreng rtsal rigs bzhi/ drag po khro bcu/ kī la bzhi/ sgo ma bzhi/ bstan srung sde gsum/ dregs byed 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi sngon gyi las dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bar gcod/ nad gdon bgegs rigs mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ tshe dang srog lus dbang thang la bar du gcod pa thams cad med cing zhi ba dang*/ gnas skabs su tshe dang dpal 'byor bsod nams snyan grags thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ mthar thug sa dang lam gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi nas myur du bla ma thod phreng rtsal gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi go 'phang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gtor ma spyi bor bskur/ de dag gis bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal gyi rjes su gnang ba yongs su rdzogs pa thob pas/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams srog ltar bsrung snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum bya/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ rjes chog las gzhung ltar bya'o// de ltar bla ma drag po pad+ma gling pa'i lugs kyi rjes gnang mdor bsdus 'di'ang*/ bla ma bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis bskul ba la brten/ dge slong chos kyi grags pas sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
